about: The one list of GitHub labels of the 4 repositories (standards/github.md, section Labels; system#508, system#515). bin/labels_sync.py makes each repository hold `canonical`; bin/github_check.py renames a label outside `canonical`, `families` or `defaults` and every `old` name on open issues (no guard blocks a label: Boss is never blocked).

canonical.name: in-progress
canonical.description: An agent works this issue now; the queue skips it

canonical.name: status:review
canonical.description: Merged; an agent re-checks the proof on its Proof date

canonical.name: blocked:access
canonical.description: Waits for an access; the line is in Accesses agents need

canonical.name: later
canonical.description: Waits for another issue first; the engineer does not take it

canonical.name: owner:boss
canonical.description: Boss decides: the issue waits for his answer

canonical.name: boss:question
canonical.description: Boss was asked one question; his next answer removes it

canonical.name: auto-fixed
canonical.description: Fixed and proved in the run that found it; the issue is the log

canonical.name: auditor
canonical.description: Opened by an auditor; closes when its check is green

canonical.name: repeat
canonical.description: A closed cause came back: the first fix missed the root cause

canonical.name: memory
canonical.description: A record, not work: the engineer queue skips it

canonical.name: engineer:mac
canonical.description: Claimed by the Mac per-issue engineer

canonical.name: engineer:cloud
canonical.description: Claimed by the cloud per-issue engineer

canonical.name: engineer:mac-needed
canonical.description: The cloud engineer hands the issue to the Mac

canonical.name: engineer:skip
canonical.description: Sorter: not work for an engineer

canonical.name: priority:1
canonical.description: First in the engineer queue of its repository

canonical.name: priority:2
canonical.description: Second in the engineer queue of its repository

canonical.name: priority:3
canonical.description: Third in the engineer queue of its repository

canonical.name: duplicate
canonical.description: This issue already exists; closed with the link
